Browser harness swap: playwright-cli -> agent-browser. State as of 2026-09-01.

WHY (measured, not assumed): playwright-cli (npm pkg playwriter@0.2.0) is NOT broken - open/snapshot/close all exit 0 and clean up procs. Two real findings:
1. --version and --help abort with 'Assertion failed: !(handle->flags & UV_HANDLE_CLOSING)' exit 127, 3/3 runs, on Node v25.8.2. Package ships no engines field so npm never warned. Breaks preflight/version probes and && chains; does NOT affect live sessions.
2. The actual cost is snapshot VOLUME. A logged-in MOM course page snapshot measured 552 lines / 33670 bytes (~8-10k tokens per step). That is what fills context and makes long runs flail.

HEAD-TO-HEAD, identical URL myopenmath.com:
  playwright-cli snapshot      88 lines / 3897 B
  playwright-cli find --regex  29 lines / 1094 B
  agent-browser  snapshot      70 lines / 2559 B
  agent-browser  snapshot -i   29 lines / 1060 B   <-- full actionable surface, 27% of the bytes

INSTALLED: agent-browser 0.35.2 (native Rust binary, no Node, immune to the libuv abort) + Chrome for Testing 152 in ~/.agent-browser/browsers/.

NEW FILE: scripts/ab-step.mjs (82 lines, untracked). Wraps one agent-browser action in a before/after snapshot-hash so the agent can tell a no-op click from a real one. Live-tested on MOM, 4/4 paths: no-op click -> exit 3 STALLED (4s); real navigation -> exit 0 (1s); over budget -> exit 4; bad ref -> exit 1.
  node scripts/ab-step.mjs mom click @e25
  node scripts/ab-step.mjs mom --reset

TWO WINDOWS TRAPS ALREADY HANDLED IN IT:
- Node refuses to execFile a .cmd shim since CVE-2024-27980 (ENOENT then EINVAL). Fix: call node_modules/agent-browser/bin/agent-browser-win32-x64.exe directly rather than shell:true, which would re-open quoting holes.
- First version called EVERY navigation a stall because it hashed before the page landed. Fix: poll the fingerprint up to AB_SETTLE_MS (default 4000); a real change trips in ~1s, only a true no-op burns the full window.

OPEN / NEXT: proving it end to end on a real MOM task. Headed session 'mom' is up on a dedicated profile at C:\Users\shuff57\.agent-browser\profiles\mom (deliberately NOT the real Chrome profile - Chrome locks its user-data dir while running). Waiting on a manual login in that window, then a read-only course -> assessment-list walk measuring steps, bytes/snapshot and stall count against the 33670 B baseline.

CAVEAT TO CHECK FIRST: global memory says 'MOM login does not persist' and to run the session guard first. If that is right, the persistent-profile plan does not buy a durable login and the proof run needs the session-guard path instead. Verify before relying on the profile dir.

GOTCHA: 'agent-browser --headed open <url>' blocks and never returns; it still leaves a working session, so issue the next command instead of waiting on it.

- steve-desktop app (Tauri, CDP dynamic port 9222-9242, currently 9222) must be running for any of this -- launch via: cd steve-desktop && bun run tauri:dev > /tmp/tauri.log 2>&1 &, then wait for "CDP enabled on port" in that log. If port 5174 is already in use on launch, a stale Vite process is holding it -- taskkill //F //PID <that pid> first (netstat -ano | grep :5174).
- Playwright chromium.connectOverCDP is BROKEN for this app once a second shared_worker target exists in its own UI (localhost:5174) -- throws an unrecoverable assertion in playwright-core (CRBrowser._onAttachedToTarget). Use raw CDP instead: scratchpad/cdp.mjs in this session (findPage + evalOnTarget over one page targets own webSocketDebuggerUrl via Runtime.evaluate) -- same approach this repos own `verify` skill documents. Rebuild it if the scratchpad is gone; it is ~90 lines.
